brendanm_4: Felix "Parson" Brendanm arrived on Day 3 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Felix "Parson" Brendanm wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
At the Hanging Bridge, Felix "Parson" Brendanm and Yann Vee exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

At Saint-Ash crossroads, Konrad Erikvukk of the Concord and Felix "Parson" Brendanm of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix "Parson" Brendanm traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Felix "Parson" Brendanm during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Felix "Parson" Brendanm had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Severin Martinsatali crossed it, Felix "Parson" Brendanm fired. Severin Martinsatali was grazed.

A clear shot from S-F6. Felix "Parson" Brendanm grazed Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy and slid back down below the parapet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Felix "Parson" Brendanm borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.

Felix "Parson" Brendanm tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

At S-F6 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Felix "Parson" Brendanm turned around and took a shovel blow. Florian Maann of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Florian Maann of the Concord (@manmc.maann). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Felix "Parson" Brendanm shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

The medics cleaned Felix "Parson" Brendanm's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F6. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Felix "Parson" Brendanm is number 176. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Felix "Parson" Brendanm watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Felix "Parson" Brendanm has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.

The dugout has begun inventing endings to Felix "Parson" Brendanm's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix "Parson" Brendanm had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Emil Majormalprac was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Felix "Parson" Brendanm. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Fresh from training, Felix "Parson" Brendanm still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Cyril Creason, badly wounded.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Jakub "Mole" Xman, grazed. Felix "Parson" Brendanm cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Felix "Parson" Brendanm read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
brunoescobar36: Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F16 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar tried to describe the smell of Dunmarrow and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived. After the loss of Verdel Ridge, Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar helped stack spare sandbags at R-F16. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A shell landed square in R-F16. They found Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar slipped away in the night. The orderly who sat with him says he was not afraid.
The papers say Anselm Brunoescobar. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Oskar "Crow" Brunoescobar's eyes. Nobody in R-F16 argues.
Anselm Brunoescobar fixed the strap on Gideon Allistofeari's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.

Anselm Brunoescobar dreamt he was back in Dunmarrow, working as a ferryman. He woke up and said nothing all morning. Anselm Brunoescobar walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Anselm Brunoescobar and Casimir Toro divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Anselm Brunoescobar spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Anselm Brunoescobar pulled Hugo Jameson out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Anselm Brunoescobar and Jakub Virajvirxgil spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Anselm Brunoescobar listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Anselm Brunoescobar caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Anselm Brunoescobar is number 136. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F16 changed before the cheering ended. Anselm Brunoescobar shouldered another load.
The trench wall shook against Anselm Brunoescobar's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Anselm Brunoescobar changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Anselm Brunoescobar brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Anselm Brunoescobar was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at R-F16. Anselm Brunoescobar was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear of the Concord (@colemarkpearson).
Clement Brunoescobar came to the front because his cousin Anselm Brunoescobar never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse.
cadendareal2: On the way to R-C1, Arno Cadendareal tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Arno Cadendareal listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Asked what he wanted after the war, Arno Cadendareal said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on. Arno Cadendareal got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 851. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Arno Cadendareal helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Arno Cadendareal's hands still remember being a postman's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world.
Isidor Nickolaskech (Concord) and Arno Cadendareal (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at Saint-Ash crossroads for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Arno Cadendareal was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
On dawn watch at R-C1, Arno Cadendareal fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Rafael "Owl" Franz, now badly wounded.

Arno Cadendareal was hit in the hip at R-C1. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat of the Concord (@mearsiecat). Arno Cadendareal was killed at R-C1 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Karel "Tin" Mearsiecat of the Concord (@mearsiecat).
Bram Cadendareal came to the front because his cousin Arno Cadendareal never came home. He carries a cracked shaving mirror.
cherryblossom_cloud: Albin "Spark" Cloud arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a frozen apple and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Albin "Spark" Cloud was hit in the hip at Q-F9. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard of the Concord (@firekeyboard). Albin "Spark" Cloud stood up to fix a loose sandbag at Q-F9. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard of the Concord (@firekeyboard).

Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud joined Q-F9 under the shadow of Albin "Spark" Cloud's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Victory at Grey Mill. Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud could not stop listening to it.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud across the shin at Q-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard of the Concord (@firekeyboard).
Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud returned to Q-F9 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud lent Walter Paz a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Konrad "Rabbit" Cloud only heard boots on the duckboards at Q-F9, then nothing but pain. Raider: Florian "Lucky" Taishoredux of the Concord (@taishoredux).
grz_zag420: Lucien Zag came up on Day 4 carrying news from Coldwater. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Lucien Zag traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.

Splinters from a shell rained down on S-F3. Lucien Zag took one in the shoulder and had it dug out right there on the fire step. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Lucien Zag during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Lucien Zag no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Lucien Zag wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

Lucien Zag checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Lucien Zag. Lucien Zag read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Lucien Zag felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F3. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Leopold "Saint" Hop of the Concord (@its.hop_).

Lucien Zag came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Lucien Zag watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

The whole squad at S-F3 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Lucien Zag's bullet that found Teodor "Smokes" Henrywestgam, grazed. A round went through Lucien Zag's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Emil Nayam of the Concord (@n.nayam2). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Lucien Zag is number 256. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Lucien Zag listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

A single shot from across the wire hit Lucien Zag in the thigh at S-F3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Pavel Saturdaynigh of the Concord (@saturdaynightinafieldrunning). A single shot at S-F3. Lucien Zag sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Pavel Saturdaynigh of the Concord (@saturdaynightinafieldrunning).
A letter came with Arno Zag: "I am Lucien Zag's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
A newspaper reached Arno Zag with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Arno Zag said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.

Across from S-F3, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Arno Zag saw it. Hugo Thegreat was badly wounded. Arno Zag fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Ivo Penigorouspe, badly wounded. The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Arno Zag fired, and Otto Summacon was grazed.

A bullet found Arno Zag at S-F3, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Norbert Cipowski of the Concord (@gavin_cipowski). Arno Zag stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F3. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Norbert Cipowski of the Concord (@gavin_cipowski).
The House of Zag sent Dorian Zag after Arno Zag. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
heheheha1939: Severin Heheheha unpacked a frozen apple at S-F14. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Severin Heheheha's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech.

Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Severin Heheheha watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. Orders came through: Severin Heheheha is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a frozen apple.
Felix Varsikasikra saw Severin Heheheha freeze up on the fire step at the Sunken Road. Felix said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
A clear shot from S-F14. Severin Heheheha gravely wounded Felix "Bones" Owenhart and slid back down below the parapet.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F14 and grazed Severin Heheheha's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. A letter from home reached Severin Heheheha before dusk. Severin Heheheha read it twice and slept a little easier. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Severin Heheheha folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
The medics cleaned Severin Heheheha's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F14.
Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony spotted Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord repairing a parapet at Blackwater Canal. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.

Face blackened with soot, Severin Heheheha spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Clement Tsanev was gravely wounded. Severin Heheheha reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F14 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Clement Tsanev of the Concord (@vl.tsanev).
Severin Heheheha rejoined the squad at S-F14. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Severin Heheheha watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Severin Heheheha had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Clement "Spark" Kid crossed it, Severin Heheheha fired. Clement "Spark" Kid was grazed. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at S-F14 changed before the cheering ended. Severin Heheheha shouldered another load. Severin Heheheha left the work of a sniper to become a machine gunner. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

A bullet went through Severin Heheheha's sleeve at S-F14 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Nils Lafayette of the Concord (@marquis_de_lafayette1757_1834). A letter from home reached Severin Heheheha before dusk. Severin Heheheha read it twice and slept a little easier.
The medic cut the last bandage off Severin Heheheha's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F14 the same hour.

Severin Heheheha went out with the wiring party at S-F14. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Severin Heheheha before dusk. Severin Heheheha read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin Heheheha had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Karel Stefan was grazed. Severin Heheheha raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Silas Wwjd of the Concord (@aidengmj_wwjd). A letter from home reached Severin Heheheha before dusk. Severin Heheheha read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin Heheheha's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F14 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The letter for Severin Heheheha ended with 'come home soon'. Severin Heheheha read the last line more than the rest.
hensley_jonas215: The draft reached S-R11 on Day 9. Karel Jonas was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Karel Jonas joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Karel Jonas wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet went through Karel Jonas's sleeve at S-R11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Ivo Maupat of the Hegemony (@maupat_03). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Jonas answered to number 838. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Karel Jonas read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet hit Karel Jonas in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-R11. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Otto Aegisdirecti of the Hegemony (@aegisdirectivee).
Karel Jonas spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
There was never a bed for Karel Jonas, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-R11 on his own feet.
Across the wire at Hill 304, Karel Jonas of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Dietrich Holt of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'

Karel Jonas counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta never saw the shovel coming. (@slightlyretarded69) Karel Jonas jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Lucien Theramblingb. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@theramblingbot)
jack.snibbe: At the depot, Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe had practised answering to his name. At U-F12, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached U-F12 with the rations. Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe ate while listening to the revised orders.
A parcel from home held a comb. Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
The pump's fault proved to be a worn fitting. Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe made a replacement from scrap while the men returned to bailing by hand.
A pump handle snapped off in Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Hill 304. Otto "Brick" Valsteinne of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
Matthias "Shadow" Snibbe's replacement fitting held, but the intake kept clogging. He fitted a rough screen and stayed through a full shift to watch it.
juizy_44: Walter Juizy arrived with the Day 4 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Walter Juizy worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Juizy. Walter Juizy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Walter Juizy tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F21 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Juizy. Walter Juizy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Victory at Hill 304. Walter Juizy let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Dawn watch. Walter Juizy put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Severin Guy, badly wounded. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F21 and grazed Walter Juizy's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Nils Mas of the Concord (@just_mas0).
Walter Juizy no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Walter Juizy offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Walter Juizy fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Florian Monkey did not get to reply at all, grazed.

The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Walter Juizy fought Felix "Spark" Toastybweady in a trench no wider than a door. Walter Juizy came home with Felix "Spark" Toastybweady's cap badge. (@toastybweady) Walter Juizy was on the dawn watch at S-F21 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Walter Juizy was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Tobias Tyleraldridg of the Concord (@tyleraldridge45). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Walter Juizy watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Juizy. Walter Juizy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Walter Juizy is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Walter Juizy is number 284. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Walter Juizy during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Walter Juizy was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
The colonel asked who held the line at Lantern Hill last night. Every finger pointed at Walter Juizy. Lance Corporal.

Walter Juizy and Ulrich "Lucky" Robertoneill carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter Juizy. Walter Juizy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Walter Juizy aimed a step ahead and fired: Dietrich Jib, grazed. A bullet hit Walter Juizy in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F21. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni). The bearers reached Walter Juizy at S-F21 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni).
A letter came with Jonas Juizy: "I am Walter Juizy's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F21 they left Jonas Juizy behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp of the Concord (@vitocarcioppolo).
Cyril Juizy took the same post at S-F21 where Jonas Juizy stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
leyton_collins: Bastian Collins stepped off the supply cart at R-S15 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
Bastian Collins set a charge under the enemy listening post. Then he waited all night for an order that did not come.

Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Bastian Collins watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper. A letter from home reached Bastian Collins before dusk. Bastian Collins read it twice and slept a little easier.

A muddy dog crawled into R-S15 through the wire. Bastian Collins gave it half his bread. It has not left his side since. The men call it Kaiser. Bastian Collins got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 547. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Bastian Collins helped stack spare sandbags at R-S15. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Bastian Collins was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S15. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Norbert "Shadow" Peakharmon of the Hegemony (@peakharmon_ey). A letter from home reached Bastian Collins before dusk. Bastian Collins read it twice and slept a little easier.
Bastian Collins no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Kaiser has learned to carry messages in a tin on its collar. Bastian Collins is very proud. Kaiser is mainly proud of the biscuits. A letter from home reached Bastian Collins before dusk. Bastian Collins read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno Zhar and Bastian Collins argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.

The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Bastian Collins was missing. At dawn they saw Bastian Collins lying by the wire. Killed in the night raid by Marek Dream of the Hegemony (@initial_dream8.6).
Another member of the House of Collins reached the line: Florian "Crow" Collins. He asked where Bastian Collins had slept, then chose a different corner.
patrick.james.oconnor: Quentin Oconnor walked into W-F12 on Day 14 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Quentin Oconnor and two others formed a very irritated windbreak. A letter from home found Quentin Oconnor before the night shift. Quentin Oconnor folded it small and kept it close.
Quentin Oconnor found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases.
reiddemars: Day 9. The corporal put Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars reached up to fix a sandbag at R-R3 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Tobias Flyer of the Hegemony (@caboose_flyer1280102938392). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars is whole again, or near enough for the line. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars answered to number 950. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars had just lit a cigarette at R-R3 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps).
Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars rejoined the squad at R-R3. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars was hit twice at R-R3, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann). The bearers reached Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars at R-R3 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Otto Baumann of the Hegemony (@tegan_baumann).
Felix "Spark" Reiddemars asked about Hugo "Brick" Reiddemars on arriving at R-R3. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Felix "Spark" Reiddemars felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R3. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Zeno Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21).

A single shot from across the wire hit Felix "Spark" Reiddemars in the thigh at R-R3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). Felix "Spark" Reiddemars looked over the parapet at R-R3 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps).
The House of Reiddemars sent Zeno Reiddemars after Felix "Spark" Reiddemars. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
wal33d_awan: Emil Awan reported to S-S4 with a lock of hair in a matchbox sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Emil Awan spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

A bullet grazed Emil Awan's ribs at S-S4. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Ivo Pejo of the Hegemony (@aki_pejo01). Blackwater Canal is lost. Emil Awan heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Emil Awan took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-S4, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Nils Gregoriousdo of the Hegemony (@gregoriousdonder). Emil Awan got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 531. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Emil Awan read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A medic brought Emil Awan half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
The medics would not give up on Emil Awan. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to S-S4 today.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Emil Awan pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Emil Awan was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29).
Emil Awan was hit in the hip at S-S4. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Walter Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26).
xanderm7802: On Day 9 Ulrich Xanderm took a post at S-C3 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He counts everything: steps, shells, stars, and the men liked him for it.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into S-C3. Ulrich Xanderm has learned to walk bent double.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Ulrich Xanderm gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. Ulrich Xanderm got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 739. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Ulrich Xanderm looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Ulrich Xanderm tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
Ulrich Xanderm fired at a movement across the wire at S-C3. The man went down: Roland Rudransh, badly wounded.
Ulrich Xanderm saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Cyril Sardanonewsn, was grazed.
Ulrich Xanderm drew the street leading to Millbank. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Ulrich Xanderm was waiting. Benedikt "Smokes" Lfer was badly wounded. The letter for Ulrich Xanderm ended with 'come home soon'. Ulrich Xanderm read the last line more than the rest.
yma.tn_: Bram Yma arrived on Day 8 as a replacement. The men in S-S15 had been fighting for 8 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Bram Yma and Jonas Miked both swear they saw a ghost at the Hanging Bridge. Each says the other screamed first.

Bram Yma threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Cyril Bananaman was down and screaming for a medic. (@bananaman_43046) Bram Yma went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bram Yma wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Bram Yma drew the street leading to Port Abel. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bram Yma answered to number 550. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S15. Bram Yma has learned to walk bent double.
Bram Yma carried Florian Normale's rifle all the way up to the Bone Quarry after Florian twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
A shell landed close to S-S15. When the dust settled Bram Yma was still there, holding a child's drawing of a horse, laughing without sound.
Gideon Pearson and Bram Yma share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
Bram Yma drew a map of Benedikt Ahmadifard's hometown from Benedikt's stories. Benedikt says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.
Bram Yma washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.
